Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The.name: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy
Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy, The.summary: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy pits the characters from the popular Cartoon Network television show against each other in an adventure/fighting game, filled with mayhem and chaos. In Battle Mode, players can use a multitude of weapons in destructible arenas like the Desert of Doom and the Underworld. Players also have the option to play on their own or with a friend in Adventure Mode, a series of story-based missions where players can unlock new weapons and new playable characters.

Nickelodeon Party Blast.name: Nickelodeon Party Blast
Nickelodeon Party Blast.summary: Gamers will race, skate, squirt and food fight their way across various Nick-themed environments, using such characters as Invader Zim, Jimmy Neutron, SpongeBob SquarePants and The Wild Thornberrys, as well as Angelica and Tommy from Rugrats.

Rockman X - Command Mission.name: Mega Man X: Command Mission
Rockman X - Command Mission.summary:
Mega Man X: Command Mission, known as Rockman X Command Mission in Japan, is a spin-off game in the Mega Man X series. It was released in 2004 on both the PlayStation 2 and the Nintendo GameCube, making it the second-to-last game in the Mega Man X series to be released. Unique to the series, it is an RPG featuring turn-based combat and an extensive story. It plays much like Capcom's signature Breath of Fire series in several ways, thanks to the shared development team. Chronologically, it is currently the Mega Man X game set furthest in the future, taking place sometime in the twenty-third century (22XX time period); however, it is also set in an alternate timeline outside of the main storyline of the Mega Man series.

The GameCube version lets players link up to the Game Boy Advance so they can use the GBA as a treasure-hunter locator. The PS2 version contains a Mega Man X8 Demo.
